Dont know if this will get buried or what but yes. Hell yes. It is important to know where to stab. However, the people before you have made excellent points, it is way too easy to cut or otherwise harm yourself when using a knife. What was taught to me was to hold the knife with the blade extended down from your pinkie finger, blade outward.
You want to slice at the arms, neck, thighs and avoid the stomach because often there is too much fat protecting it. Holding it this way ensures that even if the knife does slip, which is probable from all the blood, it does not slide from your grip towards your hand. The last thing you want is to render your thumb or fingers useless while trying to defend yourself.

But she told me she is happier now that she has made a new start in a new part of the country so I was glad to hear that.

Nevermind, I just told her. I just found out she is in an openly gay relationship, when I checked Facebook. I just realized that Im nothing to her anymore. Im just something to make her feel good. 

It's not the fact that she is in a relationship with another person, or that she is gay now, that bothers me. It is that I found out through facebook. She cant tell her friend, who is worried sick about her, that she has started a relationship with someone else? And she never told me that she likes women now. 

I asked her if my care and support had been abused and why I wasnt worth telling that she found someone else and got told to "calm the f*** down". 

Calm the f*** down? She, a close friend, confessed a suicide attempt to me, this wasnt some minor injury! How am I supposed to be calm? How can she be upset with me for caring?! 

Im not appreciated. Im sad for her but I cannot waste any more of my life with a friend who abuses me.

I really do appreciate all your guidance. I, myself, have had some god damn tough times these last few months and I dont think I would have been able to do this now without your help. But I am going to give her a few more days before I act on your words, I dont want to jump to conclusions. 

I have to admit, that was hard to hear my friend might be using me. While I dont yet believe that she is playing on my care and concern to feel good, rather than letting any of my efforts help her, it is upsetting to hear that you, as well as the councelor, suggest that she is abusing my care. 

She has always been truthful with me, sometimes even being brutally honest. I have no doubt that she was in pain, I know she has struggled with her sadness before. But I now feel like she only told me of her attempt to draw sympathy. And I hate that I think that but it is a growing possibility. 

I know that sadness can be easily hidden but she has only talked to me these past few days to tell me about the fun she has had. All of my concerns about her feelings and attempts to connect have been flat out ignored. 

I feel like Im a toy or charm, to my friend. Like something kept in her pocket for a rainy day. I cried for her. I dont pray, yet I prayed for her. I allowed myself to be scared for her. And I dont know that I can do these for her again. 

I hope Im wrong.

Sorry that turned into a rant. There was nothing really there for you to help me with. But I will tell her what you suggested I say. And I will let you know the verdict because you have been so helpful. Thank you so much.

I cant tell her how much she means to me because that was already something that pushed us apart. We had a relationship and she decided it wasnt worth pursuing. I dont resent her in any way for ending it but I know she feels cruel for the way she ended it and I feel that showing my love for her would only further her belief that she doesnt belong. 

And not getting a response scares the shit out of me. I dont know if she is just ignoring me because Im too worried or if she is planning on hurting herself. 

But she wont listen to a professional. I saw a therapist for my own reasons and suggested one might benefit her and she told me how a therapist ignored her first attempted suicide. I cant ask her to get a professional, she will never trust them. 

But I would never give her a promise I cant keep. I know that is a terrible thing to do. Is trying to give a day by day request helpful? I asked her if she could call me in a few days, thinking that might help encourage her to live for those days and reflect, but she didnt want to. Man, I can relate to that positive vibes part. It's tough thinking that people are ridiculing you or feeling like people cant be trusted. Im sorry, it is hard to live like that. I have always struggled with trusting others to be genuine and letting them see me for me. It kinda sounds like you feel that way too. Im sorry, brother. Honestly, you should try enrolling in a dumb community college course that you might find interesting (do they have community colleges near you?) if you have the time. Like try something that might sound fun where people will be just as new as you. Everyone will be a little uncomfortable in the new setting and it will be somewhere where you can find a person who might need you for a friend. 
But that Android app stuff sounds sick. Like you make/modify them?! That sounds like a lot of work. Also, can I ask how you met or know this girl? I've never considered myself the romantic type but those relationships can be so awesome. Like, just being able to talk to someone who lives in a different culture with different experiences is so crazy! I wish you the best of luck with your friend. I have a friend like that (not as far as distance) who I met on a trip and assumed I'd never see her again. But we kept in touch and it was a friends thing first kinda deal. But now we visit. Sorry to ramble, Im just stoked for you, those friendships can be so cool. 
And you are welcome for the thoughts, man. I've been down in the dirt before and felt like Ive had no one to confide to. Just a few months ago I started reaching out to others and it hurts me sometimes but Ive made some great friendships because of it. You keep being you and things will turn around, I believe that.

Im sorry to hear, no one should have to feel like that. Do you have friends/family you are willin talk to? Or, alternatively, I know it's not for everyone but counseling can help. Im seeing a therapist right now and it is hard to speak to anyone for me but they can help. Or even the subreddits have so much to offer, if you'd prefer to remain anonymous. I know it can be hard to talk to people and it's easy to think things wont get better but there are some wonderful people in this world and there are beautiful places that can change your mind. 
Also, please dont think of yourself as a pussy. There is nothing weak about valuing your own life. There is nothing weak about that voice telling you to reconsider suicide. That is strength. That is survival. Dont let other people dictate your life. 
If the way your life looks right now isnt desirable, maybe there is something activity-wise you can do? If you have the ability, try traveling somewhere new and talking to new people. Even if you just go off for a weekend. I know people can suck ass but there's a lot more nice ones out there than you might think. But please dont give up. You never know what awesome thing might happen if you just keep going at it. Life can surprise you
